note: Halloween and harvest collide — the region's biggest pumpkin festivals plus zoo Boo.

picks.reason: Underwood Family Farms' Fall Harvest Festival — wagon rides, corn maze and pick-your-own in Moorpark.
Boo at the L.A. Zoo — costumes, trick-or-treat stations and animals, included with admission.
Gilchrist Farm's free harvest festival — pumpkin patch, farm animals and fall games in Santa Clarita.
Mr. Bones Pumpkin Patch — the Westside's most-photographed patch, with slides and a petting zoo.
Six Flags Magic Mountain's Fright Fest — daytime family thrills, haunted mazes after dark.
